_meta.purpose: CL-PHYS-03 §4 evaluation-layer subject season windows. The evaluation layer injects a REQUIRED `season_window_policy` gate for every opportunity_id present here: an hour whose LOCAL date falls outside the subject's own MM-DD window can never become a 推薦. This table exists for subjects whose seasonal window is owned by the opportunity description/evidence but is NOT modelled as a `seasonal_state` condition in the pinned contract (editing those records is forbidden).
policy: Windows are inclusive MM-DD pairs in the subject's LOCAL calendar; start > end wraps across New Year (same rule as CL-COND-A8).
A subject absent from this table gets no gate: its contract semantics stay exactly as published (abstain, never invented).
Every entry must carry source_kind + source + asserted_at so the window can be audited against the owner data it came from.
This table never overrides a contract's own seasonal_state condition; it only covers subjects that have none.
provenance_rules: source_kind=opportunity_description means the window was ASSERTED from the subject's own record text, NOT read from a sourced calendar. Those windows are exactly as precise as the text is vague: the MM-DD endpoints are a defensible reading of the description, never an official date list.
A window taken from a published event calendar must say source_kind=sourced_calendar and carry the URL + retrieved_at. No entry in this table currently qualifies.

The evaluation gate judges the hour on the PLACE's local clock, derived from the place coordinate's UTC offset. The `timezone` field on an entry is NOT read by the gate: it is kept for future use and labelled timezone_unused=true so the next reader does not trust it as the gate's clock.

name_i18n.ja: 合掌集落の冬のライトアップ

jp-072-P01.source: data/v2/opportunities/jp-072-P01.json description_i18n: 「官方點燈頁面，每年1月中–2月末，日期年度公佈」. CL-PHYS-03 (2026-11-26) asserted the MM-DD window 01-15..02-28 from that sentence.
jp-072-P01.provenance: ASSERTED FROM THE SUBJECT'S OWN DESCRIPTION, NOT FROM A SOURCED CALENDAR. The record says mid-January to end-February and that each year's exact dates are announced later; 01-15..02-28 is the widest reading of that sentence, not an official date list. If the owners ever publish the year's real light-up dates, they must replace this window (source_kind=sourced_calendar).
jp-072-P01.timezone_note: UNUSED by the evaluation gate: EVALGATE-season-window judges the LOCAL DATE from the place coordinate's UTC offset, not from this field. Kept for future use only; do not read it as the gate's clock.
